authority: Keeper-directed design; not an authorization token

tasks.title: Page and capability contracts
tasks.work: Pin each participating route, exact content representation/revision, supported task profiles and origin. Keep stale/missing content explicit.
tasks.acceptance: A changed page revision is detected; unknown or deceptive origins cannot inherit support.

tasks.title: Automatic carry and first contact
tasks.work: Reuse existing custody and canonical renderer; separate intent/personalisation from identity/delegation.
tasks.acceptance: Same key crosses two permitted origins without leaking disallowed fields; merely viewing changes neither κ nor prior.

tasks.title: Scoped permission exchange
tasks.work: Bind actual subject, audience, resource, action, task version, challenge and expiry using supported identity/delegation services.
tasks.acceptance: Wrong audience, stale challenge, revoked grant and unsupported task refuse at the receiving service.

tasks.title: Record-space task
tasks.work: Create/revise a page with an explicit space ID, expected revision and operation ID; retain append-only operation outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: Exact retry is idempotent, changed retry payload refuses, conflict preserves both prior record and pending intent.

tasks.title: Evidence and evolution
tasks.work: Retain intact originals privately; fold authorized receipt commitments through one κ/prior rule; propose graph edges for required countersign.
tasks.acceptance: JSON/PNG round-trip preserves unknown fields and evidence; no signed edge arises from viewing or an unchecked claim.

tasks.title: Earned address binding
tasks.work: Reuse current admission and DNS ladder; bind the existing space ID to a granted name without resetting knowledge.
tasks.acceptance: Dry-run verifies name/subject/space binding and policy evidence; live DNS remains a separate authorized release.

tasks.title: Federation projection
tasks.work: Manifest circulating canonical content and sealed implementation/private material; project at summary altitude with lineage.
tasks.acceptance: No private key, raw journey, internal path or unsupported live claim in generated pages; links and fork lineage survive rebuild.
